reason: Document A speaks to my worries directly. It says every pledge comes back if the goal isn't met, it promises spending reports at the library every three months, and it shows only $49,000 is left to raise, about what the town gave last time. That makes a pledge feel safe even after my ambulance-fund gift. Document B leaves out the refund guarantee and the business pledges, calls the bank's conditional pledge a "match," and still has blank placeholders.
